title: Ohm Brew Baltic Blends Iced Mango Shortfill E-Liquid
description: For an exotic, tropical burst of sunny refreshment you can’t do better than ripe mango – unless you blend it with invigorating menthol! Absolutely perfect for a hot day, or any day you need some shivering sweet refreshment. Ohm Brew’s Baltic Blends range of 50ml cool shortfills are packed full of astonishing flavour but with an invigorating icy twist. Ideal for those looking for a cooler hit or for hotter days. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape to your liking. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for a wide range of Sub Ohm Vape Kits
